name: 3D Volume Data Compression
definition: Generalization of 2D compression schemes 1 and 3 to 3D volume data, extracting vectors as shown in Figure 4.
summary: 3D Volume Data Compression is a multiresolution technique generalizing 2D vector quantization to 3D volumes, distinguished by extracting spatially correlated vectors from a 3D pyramid using Scheme 1 or 3 logic.
